calls.title: Scott / Elyse / Ashley - 4.4 narrative
calls.summary: The team discussed the launch strategy for GrowthBook 4.4, aiming to integrate AI across products to enhance user experience. Key highlights include a focus on AI-driven features in product analytics, making data accessible without SQL knowledge through the new AI Data Analyst. The meeting emphasized a managed data warehouse as the default option to enhance onboarding experiences. Governance and rollout improvements in feature flagging were highlighted, enabling safer deployments. Additionally, an AI-driven demo is planned to showcase new capabilities. The discussion also addressed the refinement of documentation and launch coordination to ensure a smooth rollout and reduce onboarding friction for users.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook 4.4, AI Data Analyst, feature flagging, managed warehouse, product analytics, launch narrative
